effects.prompt: Turn a card in any banished zone face-down?

_comment:
'**Legendary** / When this enters the arena, you may turn a card in any banished zone face-down.' Light Illusionist Instant - Figment (DuskTillDawn).

LEGENDARY NOT AUTHORED: it is in printed_keywords and fires from the card DB keywords field - re-authoring it would be a defect.

ETB TRIGGER: TRIGGERED + ON_ENTER_PLAY, mapped at trigger_types.py:30 and dispatched from Zone.add on real arena entry from a non-arena zone (state.py ~293-310) - covers resolving on the stack when played AND being put into the arena by another effect. Same shape as the sibling drafts figment_of_erudition_yellow / figment_of_triumph_yellow.

OPTIONAL CLAUSE: MAY (effect_types.py:3788-3856, read this session) - declining runs nothing in the block, which is the whole of 'you may'.

FLIP: FLIP_MATCHING (effect_types.py:3490-3506, read this session) reads face_up (default False, authored explicitly) and a canonical object target compiled by _compile_object_target (:675-804). Target {'controller': 'ANY', 'zone': 'BANISHED', 'amount': 1}: controller ANY scans BOTH heroes' zones (pids [cid, 3-cid], :754-757) - the printed unqualified 'any banished zone'; _object_zone_cards handles BANISHED directly (:493-494, returns player.banished.cards); amount 1 asks the controller to choose one card; an empty pool on both sides returns [] and nothing flips. The flip sets is_public=False (and face_down=True where the attribute exists) = 'face-down'.

WARTS DISCLOSED: (1) the shared chooser offers slugs, so face-DOWN banished cards are named in the prompt - hidden information the paper game would not reveal; engine-level, not expressible in JSON. (2) The yes/no prompt is offered even when both banished zones are empty; accepting then flips nothing, behaviourally identical to declining. (3) Same residual routing caveat as the sibling erudition draft: ON_ENTER_PLAY fires only if the Figment actually enters the arena, which depends on the DB carrying 'Figment' where the resolution router looks; card_data/slug_index.json was not readable this session to confirm.
